events.content:
I want a small app for keeping track of the books I'm reading.

When I open it I want to see what I'm currently reading and what I've finished. I want to add a book from a form, mark one as finished, and click through to a book to see its title, author and my notes. I'd like to be able to send someone a link to a single book.

Nothing fancy and no accounts. Skip the database, save the books to a JSON file so they're still there after a restart.
I'll start by checking the workspace and any project conventions, then build a small book tracker that stores books in a JSON file.

events.content:
The reading list is ready. Run `npm start` and open http://localhost:3000.

The home page shows what you are currently reading and what you have finished. Add a book from the form, open its title for the author and notes, and mark it finished from the list or the book page. Each book has its own address, shown on that page, so you can send someone a link to just that book.

Books are saved in `data/books.json`. There is no account, and they are still there after a restart. `npm test` passed, 10 tests.
